title: A submessage Label that is not a string

source.clause: §5.2.1 ("Its value field must be a string as defined by ECMA-404")
source.note: composed: negative case for §5.2.1, which is the one clause that says in so many words what type a Label has.

notes: `wrong-type` and not a violation: §5.2.1 fixes the type, so a number there is not an off-spec value of the field but a field that was never sent. A `label: null` is the other case and counts as absent (case 40), because an optional field explicitly emptied carries nothing a reader would have to refuse.
